Тимидин C10H14N2O5 = 242.2. CAS — 50-89-5. Profile Thymidine is an endogenous thymine nucleoside involved in many biological processes; it is one of the components of nucleic acids (p.2355). It was formerly given by intravenous infusion to modulate the toxicity of methotrexate but is not considered to be a substitute for calcium folinate; it may also have an antineoplas- tic action of its own.
